_comment: OPENING approved message for the Peru quiz, created and submitted live
during the session to show the approval step. Until Meta approves it the
quiz spec opens with data_use_demo_intro_es, which is already approved.
Framed for UTILITY: it names the session the participant is attending and
says what will happen, with no persuasion and no incentive.
The quick-reply button is mechanical: tapping Empezar answers the opener,
which opens the 24-hour window the quiz's buttons and list need.
Submission is irreversible - Meta has no edit - so read it here first.

twilio/quick-reply.body:
Hola {{1}}, te escribimos desde la sesión de IPA sobre encuestas por WhatsApp.

Este es el quiz corto de la sesión: 6 preguntas, unos 2 minutos. Tus respuestas son confidenciales y solo se usarán para mostrar en la sesión cómo llegan los datos.

Toca Empezar cuando quieras.
